title: Kissed Dongbei Almond Flour Dumplings
description: A midnight craving steamed dumpling that combines the nutty aroma of almond flour with a subtle sweet-salty flavor, crafted for a quick yet indulgent snack.
instructions: Combine almond flour, baking powder, and salt in a mixing bowl.
Stir in sugar and rice wine.
Add warm water and vegetable oil, mixing until a smooth dough forms.
Cover dough with plastic wrap and let rest 30 minutes to hydrate.
After resting, divide dough into 12 equal portions.
Roll each portion into a small round wrapper and place a pea-sized amount of dough in the center.
Pinch edges together to seal, forming dumplings.
Steam dumplings in a bamboo steamer for 12 minutes over high heat.
